dslRule:
<!id: jface.structuredviewer.setsorter-to-setcomparator>
<!description: Replaces deprecated StructuredViewer.setSorter with StructuredViewer.setComparator when the argument is compatible with ViewerComparator. ViewerComparator was introduced in JFace 3.3 as a replacement for ViewerSorter.>
<!severity: WARNING>

org.eclipse.jface.viewers.StructuredViewer.setSorter($sorter$)
:: instanceof($sorter$, "org.eclipse.jface.viewers.ViewerComparator")
=>
org.eclipse.jface.viewers.StructuredViewer.setComparator($sorter$)
;;
summary: Replace `StructuredViewer.setSorter()` with `StructuredViewer.setComparator()` when the provided argument is an instance of `ViewerComparator` or its subtype, as `ViewerSorter` is deprecated.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
